test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

It has / been raining / since / two hours.
solution:
The erroneous part is '**since**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is** grammatically incorrect.**
 
• Here, '**for**' should be used instead of '**since**'.
 
• ‘**For**’ refers to a specific period of time or a numerical value of time, for example for*** 2 years, for 4 weeks, for 3 hours, etc.***
 
• However, in the given question, the period of time is **2 hours. **
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *It has been raining **for** two hours.*
